sectionDiscovery.primarySelector: body > header, body > nav, main > *, body > footer

animations.notes: Next.js has no built-in animation engine. framer-motion is common but not universal. Sites may use any animation library.

quirks.description: App Router sites have NO #__next wrapper div. Content renders as direct body children. Pages Router sites wrap everything in #__next.
quirks.workaround: Check window.next.appDir to distinguish. Use body > header/main/footer for App Router, #__next > * for Pages Router.

quirks.description: App Router injects dozens to hundreds of inline <script> tags into body for RSC flight data (self.__next_f.push(...)). vercel.com had 104 such scripts.
quirks.workaround: skipSelectors already excludes script tags. Be aware that bodyDirectChildSections count is very low (3-5 visible elements) which can trigger false SPA detection.

quirks.description: Both routers inject a <next-route-announcer> custom element with Shadow DOM into the body. It's an accessibility feature for screen readers.
quirks.workaround: Add next-route-announcer to skipSelectors. Do not treat as a content section.

quirks.description: next/image rewrites src to /_next/image?url=<encoded>&w=<width>&q=<quality>. data-nimg='1' for fixed, data-nimg='fill' for responsive. Static imports go to /_next/static/media/ without optimization API.
quirks.workaround: Decode the url query parameter to get the original image URL. For static imports, use the /_next/static/media/ path directly.

quirks.description: Sites using output: 'export' cannot use /_next/image optimization API. Images serve directly from original paths or use custom loaders.
quirks.workaround: Detection must not rely on /_next/image alone. Check /_next/static/ paths which are always present.

quirks.description: window.__NEXT_DATA__ only exists on Pages Router. self.__next_f only exists on App Router. window.next exists on both. window.next.appDir === true indicates App Router.
quirks.workaround: Use window.next as primary detection. Use window.next.appDir to determine router type for downstream extraction decisions.

localSite.sectionSelector: body > header, body > nav, body > div:has(nav):not(:has(main)):not(:has(footer)), main > *, body > footer
